business_summary: Jiangsu Zhongshe Group Co., Ltd. provides engineering design consulting and general contracting services in the field of transportation, municipal administration, construction, and environment in China. The company engages in the comprehensive transportation planning for regions and cities; special transportation planning for highways, water transportation, passenger and freight hubs, ports, logistics, etc.; planning and design of transportation organization; and design, consultation, supervision, survey, test and inspection, project management, and general contracting of highways, bridges, tunnels, ports, waterways, traffic safety facilities, tracks, water supply, drainage, lighting, intelligent transportation, and other projects. It is also involved in the planning of the urban express road network, public transportation, parking lots, and intelligent transportation; planning and design of urban furniture, transportation hubs, urban complexes, and urban renewal; and construction of small towns and stations. In addition, the company offers architectural engineering design, survey, supervision, test and inspection, project management, environmental engineering, landscape architecture, intelligent transportation, smart cities, and geotechnical engineering, and general contracting services. Further, it engages in the planning, design, supervision, and livable city, sponge city, wetland park, landscape, sewage treatment, river treatment, garbage treatment, solid waste, hazardous waste treatment, soil treatment, and other activities. The company was formerly known as Wuxi Traffic Planning and Design Research Institute. Jiangsu Zhongshe Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu Zhongshe Group Co., Ltd.는 중국 내 운송, 도시 행정, 건설 및 환경 분야에서 엔지니어링 설계 컨설팅 및 일반 계약 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 지역과 도시에 대한 종합적인 교통 계획에 참여하고 있습니다. 고속도로, 해상 운송, 여객 및 화물 허브, 항만, 물류 등을 위한 특별 운송 계획; 운송 조직의 계획 및 설계; 고속도로, 교량, 터널, 항만, 수로, 교통안전 시설, 선로, 상수도, 배수, 조명, 지능형 교통 및 기타 프로젝트의 설계, 컨설팅, 감독, 조사, 시험 및 검사, 프로젝트 관리 및 일반 계약을 수행합니다. 또한 도시고속도로망, 대중교통, 주차장, 지능형교통 등의 계획에도 참여하고 있습니다. 도시 가구, 교통 허브, 도시 단지 및 도시 재개발 계획 및 설계; 그리고 작은 마을과 역의 건설. 또한 이 회사는 건축 엔지니어링 설계, 조사, 감독, 테스트 및 검사, 프로젝트 관리, 환경 엔지니어링, 조경 건축 서비스를 제공합니다.
